title: Mening, sening
hook_voice: Lesson fifteen. My, your, his, her.
hook_say: Bu kimning narsasi? Inglizcha aytishni o'rganamiz!

example.en: This is my book. That is her book.
example.uz: Bu mening kitobim. Anavi uning kitobi.

end_say: Saqlab qo'ying! Ertaga o'n oltinchi dars: oila.
caption:
0 dan ingliz tili, 15-dars: inglizcha «my», «your», «his», «her».

This is my book — Bu mening kitobim
This is your pen — Bu sening ruchkang
This is his car — Bu uning mashinasi

his — erkak kishi haqida, her — ayol kishi haqida: her book — uning kitobi. your — ham «sening», ham «sizning».
Saqlab qo'ying va ingliz tilini boshlamoqchi bo'lgan do'stingizga yuboring.
Ertaga 16-dars: Oila.
